revisions.body:
# Committing and deploying from the shared checkout

Several nodes edit `/Users/silasrhyneer/Code/heart-rush-tools` at the same time, on `main`. The uncommitted changes in `git status` are mostly not yours.

## Committing

- Commit only the files you changed: `git commit --only <path> <path> … --no-verify -m "…"`. `--only` commits those paths and leaves everything else in the index and working tree as it was.
- Never `git add -A`, `git add .`, `git commit -a`, `git stash`, `git reset --hard`, `git checkout -- <file>` or `git restore` on files you did not write. Each of these commits, hides or deletes another agent's work.
- `--no-verify` is used because the `.husky/pre-commit` hook runs `pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 build` across the whole workspace, which takes minutes and fails on other agents' half-finished files. Run the checks for the packages you touched yourself instead (typecheck, that package's tests — see [[heart-rush-tools/dev/shared-machine]] before running play's).

## When local main is behind origin

Do not pull or rebase in the shared checkout; it rewrites the working tree under other agents. Instead:

1. `git worktree add /tmp/<name> origin/main`, then `git cherry-pick <your commits>` there and resolve any conflict there.
2. Back in the shared checkout, `git reset --keep origin/main` once your commits are on origin (or `git reset --keep <the rebuilt commit>`). `--keep` moves the branch but refuses to touch a file with uncommitted changes, so other agents' edits survive.
3. Remove the temporary worktree.

## Pushing and deploying

- Push with `git push --no-verify origin main`. A push to `main` deploys: `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` deploys each Worker whose inputs changed since its `deployed/<app>` tag, and play's own deploy script runs its tests, migrations and preview checks before promoting.
- Check the run: `gh run list --limit 1` for the id, then `gh run watch <id> --exit-status`. Report a failed run with its log, not as done.
- `crtr github watch-run` returns not_found for this repo's runs (crouter#324); use `gh` until that is fixed.

summary: Commit only your paths with --no-verify; never add -A, stash, reset --hard or checkout others' files; push to main deploys via CI.
why_it_exists: Concurrent nodes share one checkout of main; a stash, add -A or reset by one agent would commit or wipe another agent's in-progress files.
